senses.en: the fact that something does not exist; lack
senses.pattern: in the absence of / the absence of evidence / a complete absence of
senses.example: In the [[absence]] of clear evidence, the judge refused to send the young man to prison.
senses.example_zh: 由於缺乏明確的證據，法官拒絕將這名年輕人送進監獄。
senses.note: in the absence of 意為「在沒有…的情況下」

gsat.sentence: The [[absence]] of smiles stemmed partly from the attempt to hide their decayed teeth caused by poor dental hygiene.
However, with the [[absence]] of gravity in the outer space, our body fluids redistribute, shifting toward the upper body and the head.

senses.en: to make the effort to do something
senses.pattern: not bother to do / not bother doing / Why bother? / Don't bother.
senses.example: Most visitors don't [[bother]] to read the long instructions posted at the entrance of the museum.
senses.example_zh: 大多數遊客都不會費心去讀博物館入口張貼的那一長串說明。
senses.note: 多用於否定句和疑問句

senses.en: a period in a person's life or in history
senses.pattern: a new chapter in life / a dark chapter in history / close a chapter
senses.example: Moving abroad for college opened an exciting new [[chapter]] in Mina's life.
senses.example_zh: 出國念大學為米娜的人生開啟了令人興奮的新階段。

senses.en: a local branch of a club or organization
senses.pattern: a local chapter / the Tokyo chapter of the club / chapter members
senses.example: She joined the local [[chapter]] of a wildlife protection group and helped clean the beach every month.
senses.example_zh: 她加入了一個野生動物保護團體的當地分會，每個月幫忙淨灘。

gsat.sentence: The news made headlines around the world, not only for the incredible achievement of the search team, but because the discovery marked the final [[chapter]] in a legendary story of extraordinary courage and perseverance.

Last week Jay McCarroll and The HSUS (The Humane Society of the United States) made a bold fur-free statement on the runway, marking <u>a new [[chapter]]</u> for the fashion industry and animal protection.

senses.en: knowledge of and skill in something, especially a language
senses.pattern: a good command of English / have command of / an excellent command of
senses.example: Thanks to her excellent [[command]] of Japanese, Rita was chosen to guide the visiting exchange students.
senses.example_zh: 由於日語運用能力極佳，麗塔獲選為來訪的交換學生擔任嚮導。
senses.note: 常用 a good command of＋語言

senses.en: to deserve and get respect, attention, or a high price
senses.pattern: command respect / command attention / command a high price
senses.example: The doctor's honesty and skill [[command]] the trust of everyone in the small town.
senses.example_zh: 這位醫生的誠實與醫術，博得了小鎮上每個人的信任。

gsat.sentence: With a good [[command]] of both Chinese and English, Miss Lin was assigned the task of oral interpretation for the visiting American delegation.
Some coins may [[command]] higher prices because they are more popular with collectors.

senses.en: an illness or health problem, often a lasting one
senses.pattern: a heart condition / a medical condition / a skin condition / a rare condition
senses.example: Because of a heart [[condition]], my grandfather has to take medicine every morning and avoid salty food.
senses.example_zh: 因為心臟疾病，我爺爺每天早上都得吃藥，並且避免吃太鹹的食物。
senses.note: 此義為可數名詞

senses.en: to train someone to think or behave in a certain way
senses.pattern: be conditioned to do sth / be conditioned by society / condition sb to accept sth
senses.example: Years of advertising have [[conditioned]] shoppers to believe that a higher price always means better quality.
senses.example_zh: 多年來的廣告已使消費者習慣於相信，價格越高品質一定越好。
senses.note: 多用被動 be conditioned to V

gsat.sentence: Synesthesia is a [[condition]] in which people’s senses intermix.
While the twins knew that genetics might have played a role in their [[condition]], they recognized that their eating habits might have also contributed to their heart problems.

senses.en: to stop something harmful from spreading
senses.pattern: contain the fire / contain the outbreak / contain the spread of
senses.example: Firefighters worked through the night to [[contain]] the blaze before it reached nearby homes.
senses.example_zh: 消防員徹夜搶救，要趕在大火延燒到附近住家之前控制住火勢。

senses.en: to keep your feelings under control
senses.pattern: contain one's excitement / contain one's anger / can hardly contain oneself
senses.example: When her name was announced as the winner, she could hardly [[contain]] her excitement.
senses.example_zh: 當她的名字被宣布為優勝者時，她幾乎克制不住內心的興奮。

senses.en: to force someone into a place with no escape
senses.pattern: corner a suspect / feel cornered / a cornered animal
senses.example: The security guards finally [[cornered]] the thief in the parking garage, where he had nowhere to run.
senses.example_zh: 警衛終於在停車場把小偷逼入絕境，讓他無處可逃。

senses.en: to control the whole supply of a product
senses.pattern: corner the market / corner the market in sth / corner the supply of
senses.example: By buying every small rival, the firm has nearly [[cornered]] the market in organic tea.
senses.example_zh: 藉由收購所有小型對手，這家公司幾乎壟斷了有機茶市場。

senses.en: to talk too proudly about your own success
senses.pattern: crow about / crow over a victory / nothing to crow about
senses.example: He kept [[crowing]] about his perfect score until his classmates stopped listening to him.
senses.example_zh: 他不停誇耀自己考滿分，直到同學都不想再聽。

senses.en: (of a rooster) to make a loud, high cry
senses.pattern: the rooster crows / crow at dawn / crow loudly
senses.example: On my uncle's farm, we got up every morning as soon as the rooster [[crowed]].
senses.example_zh: 在舅舅的農場，每天早上公雞一啼叫我們就起床。

senses.en: strange or unusual
senses.pattern: a curious thing / a curious mixture of / it is curious that / curiously enough
senses.example: It is [[curious]] that the museum's oldest painting has no signature or date on it.
senses.example_zh: 奇怪的是，博物館裡最古老的那幅畫上既沒有簽名也沒有日期。
senses.note: 此義多修飾事物，而不是人

senses.en: the act of giving birth to a baby
senses.pattern: a difficult delivery / the delivery room / a natural delivery
senses.example: After a long and difficult [[delivery]], both the mother and her baby girl were healthy.
senses.example_zh: 經過漫長而艱難的分娩，母親和女嬰都平安健康。

senses.en: the way someone speaks or performs in public
senses.pattern: a confident delivery / improve one's delivery / a clear delivery
senses.example: The speech itself was short, but her calm, confident [[delivery]] impressed all the judges.
senses.example_zh: 演講本身很短，但她沉穩自信的演說方式讓所有評審印象深刻。
senses.note: 動詞：deliver a speech 發表演說

senses.en: a disagreement between people
senses.pattern: settle their differences / put aside differences / have their differences / resolve differences
senses.example: The two roommates finally settled their [[differences]] and agreed to share the housework equally.
senses.example_zh: 兩位室友終於化解了意見分歧，同意平均分擔家事。
senses.note: 此義常用複數 differences

senses.en: the amount by which one number is greater than another
senses.pattern: pay the difference / make up the difference / split the difference
senses.example: If you change to a larger room, you only need to pay the [[difference]] in price.
senses.example_zh: 如果您換到較大的房間，只需補足價格的差額。

senses.en: a wide difference between two groups
senses.pattern: the digital divide / the urban-rural divide / a cultural divide / bridge the divide
senses.example: The survey revealed a widening [[divide]] between rich and poor families in access to private tutoring.
senses.example_zh: 調查顯示，富裕與貧窮家庭在補習資源上的落差日益擴大。

senses.en: expected to arrive or happen at a particular time
senses.pattern: be due at noon / be due to arrive / be due back
senses.example: The next train is not [[due]] for another forty minutes, so let's grab some coffee first.
senses.example_zh: 下一班火車預定四十分鐘後才到，我們先去買杯咖啡吧。
senses.note: 不用於名詞前

senses.en: proper or right in the situation
senses.pattern: with due respect / due care / after due consideration / in due course
senses.example: After [[due]] consideration, the committee decided to give the young scientist a second chance.
senses.example_zh: 經過適當的考量後，委員會決定再給這位年輕科學家一次機會。
senses.note: 只用於名詞前；in due course 在適當時候

gsat.sentence: Do you know what time the next bus is [[due]]? I’ve been waiting here for more than 30 minutes.

senses.en: to suggest an idea for others to consider
senses.pattern: float an idea / float a proposal / float a plan
senses.example: At the meeting, one teacher [[floated]] the idea of starting classes an hour later.
senses.example_zh: 會議上，一位老師提出了晚一小時上課的想法。

senses.en: a decorated vehicle in a parade
senses.pattern: a parade float / a carnival float / decorate a float
senses.example: Each class decorated a [[float]] with flowers and balloons for the school's anniversary parade.
senses.example_zh: 每個班級都用鮮花和氣球裝飾一輛花車，參加校慶遊行。

senses.en: although; used to admit a small weak point
senses.pattern: comfortable, if a little small / pleasant, if noisy / polite, if cold
senses.example: The hotel room was comfortable, [[if]] a little small, and the view was wonderful.
senses.example_zh: 這間飯店房間雖然有點小，但很舒適，景觀也很棒。
senses.note: 後接形容詞或副詞，表讓步

senses.en: an uncertain possibility or condition
senses.pattern: a big if / ifs and buts / too many ifs
senses.example: The team could still win the title, but that is a very big [[if]].
senses.example_zh: 這支隊伍仍有可能奪冠，但那還是個很大的未知數。

senses.en: a tool or device used for precise or scientific work
senses.pattern: a surgical instrument / a measuring instrument / scientific instruments
senses.example: Doctors use a special [[instrument]] to look inside a patient's ear.
senses.example_zh: 醫生使用一種特殊儀器來檢查病人的耳朵內部。

senses.en: something used to achieve a particular result
senses.pattern: an instrument of change / an instrument for peace / an instrument of control
senses.example: Education can be a powerful [[instrument]] for reducing poverty in developing countries.
senses.example_zh: 教育可以成為開發中國家減少貧窮的有力手段。

gsat.sentence: The [[instrument]] is used to measure how a person’s body reacts to questions.
A paperclip, made of steel wire bent into a hooped shape, is an [[instrument]] used to hold sheets of paper together.

senses.en: (of knowledge) very detailed and thorough
senses.pattern: an intimate knowledge of / an intimate understanding of / an intimate acquaintance with
senses.example: After thirty years as a tour guide, Mr. Lin has an [[intimate]] knowledge of the old city's back streets.
senses.example_zh: 當了三十年導遊，林先生對舊城區的大街小巷有極為詳盡的了解。

senses.en: (of a place or event) small, quiet, and friendly
senses.pattern: an intimate restaurant / an intimate atmosphere / an intimate gathering
senses.example: The singer prefers small, [[intimate]] concert halls where she can see every face in the audience.
senses.example_zh: 這位歌手偏好小而溫馨私密的音樂廳，在那裡她能看見每一位觀眾的臉。

senses.en: to say or show something in an indirect way
senses.pattern: intimate that… / intimate one's wishes / intimate to sb that…
senses.example: In his speech, the coach [[intimated]] that he might retire after the next season.
senses.example_zh: 教練在演說中暗示，他可能在下個球季結束後退休。
senses.note: 動詞讀作 /ˈɪntəˌmet/；正式用語

gsat.sentence: They broke into small, [[intimate]] table conversations, recording their insights on paper tablecloths.

senses.en: a serious magazine about a particular subject or profession
senses.pattern: a medical journal / a scientific journal / an academic journal / publish in a journal
senses.example: Her study on sleep and memory was published in a leading medical [[journal]] last month.
senses.example_zh: 她關於睡眠與記憶的研究上個月刊登在一份頂尖的醫學期刊上。

senses.en: an event marking an important stage in development
senses.pattern: a landmark in the history of / a major landmark / a landmark in medicine
senses.example: The invention of the printing press was a [[landmark]] in the history of human communication.
senses.example_zh: 印刷機的發明是人類傳播史上的里程碑。

senses.en: very important and marking a turning point
senses.pattern: a landmark decision / a landmark study / a landmark agreement
senses.example: In a [[landmark]] study, researchers followed five thousand children for thirty years to track their health.
senses.example_zh: 在一項具里程碑意義的研究中，研究人員追蹤五千名兒童的健康狀況長達三十年。
senses.note: 只用於名詞前

senses.en: a device that measures the amount of something used
senses.pattern: a parking meter / a water meter / an electricity meter / read the meter
senses.example: A worker comes every two months to read the gas [[meter]] outside our kitchen.
senses.example_zh: 每兩個月會有人員來抄我們廚房外的瓦斯表。
senses.note: 計程車的計費表也叫 meter

senses.en: the rhythmic pattern of a poem
senses.pattern: poetic meter / rhyme and meter / a regular meter
senses.example: Our teacher asked us to clap along to feel the [[meter]] of the poem as she read.
senses.example_zh: 老師朗讀時要我們跟著拍手，感受這首詩的格律。
senses.note: 英式拼法 metre

senses.en: to base something on the design of something else
senses.pattern: be modeled on / be modeled after / model oneself on
senses.example: The new library was [[modeled]] on a famous reading room in an old European university.
senses.example_zh: 這座新圖書館是仿照一所歐洲古老大學裡著名的閱覽室建造的。
senses.note: 英式拼法：modelled

senses.en: a person or thing that is a good example to copy
senses.pattern: a model of efficiency / serve as a model for / a role model
senses.example: The city's recycling program has become a [[model]] for other towns hoping to reduce waste.
senses.example_zh: 該市的資源回收計畫已成為其他想減少垃圾的城鎮的典範。
senses.note: 作形容詞（名詞前）：a model student 模範生

gsat.sentence: Early table forks were [[modeled]] after kitchen forks, but small pieces of food often fell through the two tines or slipped off easily.
Following him, many local people opened their own bookshops, and the small town soon became a [[model]] of sustainable rural development and tourism.

senses.en: the courage to do something difficult
senses.pattern: have the nerve to / lose your nerve / keep your nerve / it takes nerve to
senses.example: The shy boy finally found the [[nerve]] to sing alone on stage at the talent show.
senses.example_zh: 那個害羞的男孩終於鼓起勇氣，在才藝表演中獨自上台唱歌。
senses.note: have the nerve to 亦指「竟敢、厚臉皮」

senses.en: feelings of worry or anxiety
senses.pattern: calm your nerves / exam nerves / a bundle of nerves / suffer from nerves
senses.example: She took a few deep breaths to calm her [[nerves]] before the piano competition began.
senses.example_zh: 鋼琴比賽開始前，她深呼吸幾次來緩和緊張的情緒。

senses.en: all the persons of a nation or ethnic group
senses.pattern: the peoples of Asia / a proud people / indigenous peoples
senses.example: The museum displays tools and clothing made by the native [[peoples]] of the Arctic.
senses.example_zh: 這間博物館展出北極地區各原住民族製作的工具和服飾。
senses.note: 此義為可數：a people、peoples

senses.en: to live in a place or fill it with people
senses.pattern: be peopled by farmers / be peopled with characters / a thinly peopled area
senses.example: The remote valley was once [[peopled]] by farmers who grew rice on its steep hillsides.
senses.example_zh: 曾有農民居住於這座偏遠山谷，在陡峭的山坡上種稻。
senses.note: 多用被動：be peopled by／with

gsat.sentence: Critics of the country say that drinking is almost an inherent trait of the Russian [[people]].

senses.en: the mark used at the end of a sentence
senses.pattern: put a period / end with a period / a period at the end
senses.example: Remember to put a [[period]] at the end of every statement in your English composition.
senses.example_zh: 記得在英文作文的每個直述句句尾加上句號。
senses.note: 美式用法；英式稱 full stop

senses.en: used to show that a decision is final
senses.pattern: …, period. / No excuses, period. / I'm not going, period.
senses.example: You are not going to the concert on a school night, [[period]]!
senses.example_zh: 平日晚上你不准去聽演唱會，就這樣，不必多說！
senses.note: 口語；置於句尾表示沒有商量餘地

senses.en: to imagine someone or something in your mind
senses.pattern: picture sb doing sth / picture oneself as sth / picture the scene
senses.example: I can still [[picture]] my grandmother standing at the stove, humming as she cooked.
senses.example_zh: 我至今仍能想像出奶奶站在爐子前，一邊煮飯一邊哼歌的模樣。

senses.en: a situation, or a general understanding of it
senses.pattern: the big picture / get the picture / a clear picture of sth / the overall picture
senses.example: Interviews with local farmers gave researchers a clearer [[picture]] of how the drought had affected them.
senses.example_zh: 訪談當地農民後，研究人員更清楚旱災影響他們的實際情況。

gsat.sentence: Steve’s description of the place was so vivid that I could almost [[picture]] it in my mind.

senses.en: to value something very highly
senses.pattern: be prized for / be highly prized / prize freedom
senses.example: This rare tea is highly [[prized]] by collectors for its rich flavor and long history.
senses.example_zh: 這種稀有的茶因風味濃郁、歷史悠久而深受收藏家珍視。
senses.note: 常用被動；prized（adj.）珍貴的

gsat.sentence: Cartier-Bresson’s subsequent work to document Gandhi’s death and its immediate impact on the country became one of Life Magazine’s most [[prized]] photo essays.
They were [[prized]] possessions made of expensive materials intended to impress guests.

senses.en: itself; in the strict sense (used after a noun)
senses.pattern: the city proper / the test proper / the meeting proper
senses.example: The welcome speech lasted so long that the concert [[proper]] did not begin until nine.
senses.example_zh: 歡迎致詞拖得太久，音樂會本身直到九點才開始。
senses.note: 此義須置於名詞之後

senses.en: real; good enough to be called by that name
senses.pattern: a proper meal / a proper job / a proper holiday / a proper bed
senses.example: After a week of instant noodles, the hikers were eager for a [[proper]] meal.
senses.example_zh: 吃了一星期的泡麵後，這群登山客很想吃一頓像樣的飯。
senses.note: 此義多見於英式英語，只放在名詞前

senses.en: a force that attracts or draws something
senses.pattern: the pull of gravity / the pull of the moon / feel the pull of the city
senses.example: The moon's [[pull]] on the oceans causes the tides to rise and fall twice a day.
senses.example_zh: 月球對海洋的引力使潮汐每天漲落兩次。

senses.en: to injure a muscle by stretching it too much
senses.pattern: pull a muscle / pull a hamstring / a pulled muscle
senses.example: He [[pulled]] a muscle in his leg during the race and had to stop running.
senses.example_zh: 他在比賽中拉傷了腿部肌肉，不得不停下來。

gsat.sentence: In the earlier days of space travel, scientists tried to overcome the force of gravity so that a rocket could shoot free of Earth’s [[pull]] in order to land humans on the moon.

senses.en: a line of mountains or hills
senses.pattern: a mountain range / a range of hills / a coastal range
senses.example: A snow-covered [[range]] of mountains separates the dry desert from the green coastal plain.
senses.example_zh: 一條白雪覆蓋的山脈，把乾燥的沙漠和翠綠的沿海平原隔開。

senses.en: to vary between two stated limits
senses.pattern: range from A to B / range between A and B / range in age from
senses.example: Ticket prices for the concert [[range]] from eight hundred to five thousand dollars.
senses.example_zh: 這場演唱會的票價從八百元到五千元不等。

gsat.sentence: These methods [[range]] from a simple step like makeup to a drastic one like surgery.
But some mountain [[ranges]] of South America, Africa, and Indonesia are also home to glaciers and ice sheets.

senses.en: to react to something in a particular way
senses.pattern: be well received / be warmly received / be poorly received
senses.example: The director's first film was warmly [[received]] by critics, who praised its honest storytelling.
senses.example_zh: 這位導演的首部電影獲得影評人極高的評價，他們稱讚其敘事真誠。
senses.note: 常用被動：be well received 受好評

senses.en: to welcome a guest or visitor formally
senses.pattern: receive guests / receive visitors / receive a delegation
senses.example: The ambassador [[received]] the visiting students in the garden and showed them around the embassy.
senses.example_zh: 大使在花園接待來訪的學生，並帶他們參觀大使館。
senses.note: reception 接待；歡迎會

gsat.sentence: The story was well [[received]] by the group, but then she put it away, thinking she was done with it.
American presidents can express their individual style in how they decorate the house and in how they [[receive]] the public.

senses.en: to try to do something
senses.pattern: seek to do sth / seek to improve / seek to reduce / seek to understand
senses.example: The new program [[seeks]] to reduce food waste in school cafeterias across the country.
senses.example_zh: 這項新計畫試圖減少全國學校餐廳的食物浪費。
senses.note: 後接 to V；過去式為 sought

senses.en: to ask someone for advice, help, or permission
senses.pattern: seek advice / seek help / seek permission / seek medical attention
senses.example: If the headaches continue for more than a week, you should [[seek]] medical advice.
senses.example_zh: 如果頭痛持續超過一週，你應該尋求醫師的建議。

gsat.sentence: Finally, when he was cruelly abused for not winning medals at the 2013 World Championships in Brazil, he decided to [[seek]] protection.
Recently, however, the International Olive Council (IOC) is [[seeking]] input on test methods to improve the transparency of the testing process and boost the accuracy of the results.

senses.en: a new part growing from a plant
senses.pattern: bamboo shoots / green shoots / new shoots / young shoots
senses.example: After the spring rain, tiny green [[shoots]] began to appear all over the vegetable garden.
senses.example_zh: 春雨過後，菜園裡到處開始冒出細小的綠色嫩芽。
senses.note: bamboo shoots＝竹筍

senses.en: to move suddenly and very quickly
senses.pattern: shoot past / shoot across the sky / shoot out of / shoot ahead
senses.example: A bright meteor [[shot]] across the night sky and disappeared behind the mountains.
senses.example_zh: 一顆明亮的流星飛快劃過夜空，消失在群山之後。
senses.note: 過去式、過去分詞為 shot

senses.en: an occasion when photos or a film are taken
senses.pattern: a photo shoot / a film shoot / a fashion shoot / on a shoot
senses.example: The model arrived two hours early for the magazine's photo [[shoot]] at the beach.
senses.example_zh: 那位模特兒提早兩小時抵達海邊，準備進行雜誌的照片拍攝。

gsat.sentence: Jesse is a talented model. He can easily adopt an elegant pose for a camera [[shoot]].
In the earlier days of space travel, scientists tried to overcome the force of gravity so that a rocket could [[shoot]] free of Earth’s pull in order to land humans on the moon.

senses.en: to make someone stop speaking or criticizing
senses.pattern: silence the crowd / silence one's critics / silence opposition
senses.example: The teacher [[silenced]] the noisy class with a single look and then continued the lesson.
senses.example_zh: 老師只用一個眼神就使吵鬧的全班安靜下來，然後繼續上課。

gsat.sentence: wanted to [[silence]] a complaining diner

senses.en: only; just; for no other reason than
senses.pattern: simply because / simply a matter of / simply by doing
senses.example: Many students skip breakfast [[simply]] because they would rather sleep ten more minutes.
senses.example_zh: 許多學生不吃早餐，只不過是因為寧願多睡十分鐘。

senses.en: used to emphasize how strong a statement is
senses.pattern: simply amazing / simply wonderful / simply cannot / simply not true
senses.example: The view from the mountaintop at sunrise was [[simply]] breathtaking.
senses.example_zh: 日出時從山頂望出去的景色簡直美得令人屏息。
senses.note: 與否定連用：simply cannot＝實在無法

gsat.sentence: Music was moving out of the relatively small halls of Mozart’s day into the large concert halls of the 19th century, and without amplification, the glass armonica [[simply]] couldn’t be heard.
Capoeiristas learned to camouflage the forbidden fights with singing, clapping, and dancing as though it were [[simply]] entertainment.

senses.en: not strict or severe enough
senses.pattern: be soft on / go soft on / be too soft with / take a soft line
senses.example: Some parents complain that the school is too [[soft]] on students who bully others.
senses.example_zh: 有些家長抱怨學校對霸凌他人的學生太過寬容。
senses.note: have a soft spot for 特別喜愛

senses.en: not bright, loud, or harsh; pleasant and gentle
senses.pattern: soft light / soft music / a soft voice / soft colors
senses.example: The café uses [[soft]] lighting and quiet music to help customers relax after work.
senses.example_zh: 這家咖啡館用柔和的燈光和輕音樂，幫助顧客下班後放鬆。

senses.en: a person's mood or state of mind
senses.pattern: in high spirits / in low spirits / lift sb's spirits / raise sb's spirits
senses.example: The whole class was in high [[spirits]] after winning the school singing contest.
senses.example_zh: 贏得校內歌唱比賽後，全班情緒十分高昂。
senses.note: 作此義時用複數

senses.en: strong alcoholic drink such as whisky
senses.pattern: wine and spirits / a tax on spirits / a bottle of spirits
senses.example: The restaurant serves beer and wine but does not sell [[spirits]] such as whisky.
senses.example_zh: 這家餐廳供應啤酒和葡萄酒，但不賣威士忌之類的烈酒。

senses.en: a ghost or the soul of a dead person
senses.pattern: evil spirits / the spirits of the dead / ancestral spirits / drive away spirits
senses.example: Villagers once set off firecrackers at midnight to drive evil [[spirits]] away from their homes.
senses.example_zh: 村民從前會在午夜放鞭炮，把邪惡的鬼魂趕出家門。

gsat.sentence: Surprisingly, the audience listened with full focus and high [[spirits]].
Obon, or the Bon Festival, is a Japanese holiday that honors the [[spirits]] of the dead.

senses.en: to appear or become known after being hidden
senses.pattern: problems surface / doubts surface / new evidence surfaced
senses.example: Old arguments between the two brothers [[surfaced]] again when they had to share a room.
senses.example_zh: 這對兄弟被迫共用一個房間時，過去的爭執又再度浮現。

senses.en: to rise to the top of the water
senses.pattern: surface for air / surface to breathe / the diver surfaced
senses.example: The whale [[surfaced]] beside our boat, took a deep breath, and disappeared into the waves.
senses.example_zh: 那頭鯨魚在我們的船邊浮出水面，深吸一口氣，然後消失在海浪中。

gsat.sentence: Mistrust increases and rejection and repression [[surface]].

senses.en: a lack of something; the state of being poor
senses.pattern: for want of / for want of a better word / live in want
senses.example: Many young trees in the park died for [[want]] of water during the long dry summer.
senses.example_zh: 在漫長乾燥的夏天，公園裡許多小樹因缺乏水分而枯死。
senses.note: for want of＝因為缺乏

senses.en: (of the police) to be searching for a suspect
senses.pattern: be wanted by the police / be wanted for robbery / a wanted man
senses.example: The man is [[wanted]] by police in three countries for stealing valuable paintings.
senses.example_zh: 那名男子因偷竊名貴畫作而遭三國警方通緝。
senses.note: 常用被動；wanted（adj.）被通緝的

senses.en: something that causes great admiration or surprise
senses.pattern: a natural wonder / the wonders of nature / the Seven Wonders of the World
senses.example: The Grand Canyon is one of the natural [[wonders]] that attract millions of visitors every year.
senses.example_zh: 大峽谷是每年吸引數百萬遊客的自然奇觀之一。
senses.note: no wonder＝難怪

senses.en: a feeling of surprise and admiration
senses.pattern: in wonder / a sense of wonder / be filled with wonder
senses.example: The children stared in [[wonder]] as the magician pulled a live rabbit out of an empty hat.
senses.example_zh: 魔術師從空帽子裡拉出一隻活兔子時，孩子們驚奇地睜大眼睛看著。
senses.note: 此義不可數

gsat.sentence: This common device is a [[wonder]] of simplicity and function.

senses.en: a promise that you will do something
senses.pattern: keep one's word / give sb one's word / break one's word / a man of his word
senses.example: Dad gave us his [[word]] that he would be home in time for the school play.
senses.example_zh: 爸爸向我們保證，他一定會及時回家看學校的話劇表演。
senses.note: 此義只用單數

senses.en: a piece of news or a message
senses.pattern: send word / receive word / word came that / spread the word
senses.example: We waited all night, but no [[word]] came from the rescue team on the mountain.
senses.example_zh: 我們等了一整夜，山上的搜救隊卻始終沒有傳來任何消息。
senses.note: 不可數；動詞 word 指「措辭」

quiz.stem: The content of Kevin's speech was excellent, but his flat, hurried ______ made it hard for the audience to stay interested.
quiz.explain_zh: delivery＝演說方式。內容很好，但平淡急促的表達方式讓聽眾難以專心。

quiz.stem: The novelist grew up in the fishing port, and her ______ understanding of the fishermen's daily struggles makes her stories feel real.
quiz.explain_zh: intimate＝詳盡的、深入的。小說家在漁港長大，對漁民的辛苦有深入的了解。

quiz.stem: Doubts about the safety of the new drug ______ last month when several patients reported severe headaches and dizziness after taking it.
quiz.explain_zh: surface＝浮現、顯露。數名病人服藥後頭痛暈眩，新藥安全的疑慮隨之浮現。

quiz.stem: It takes a lot of ______ to stand up in front of the whole school and admit that you made a serious mistake.
quiz.explain_zh: nerve＝勇氣、膽量。在全校面前承認自己犯了大錯，需要很大的勇氣。

quiz.stem: The pianist's performance last night was ______ amazing; the audience stood and clapped for nearly five minutes after the final piece.
quiz.explain_zh: simply＝簡直、實在。鋼琴家的演出簡直太精采，觀眾起立鼓掌近五分鐘。

quiz.stem: Critics say the judge was too ______ on the factory owner, who was fined only a small amount for polluting the river.
quiz.explain_zh: soft＝寬容的。法官只對污染河川的工廠老闆處以小額罰款，被批太寬容。

quiz.stem: Health officials moved quickly to ______ the outbreak by closing schools and tracing everyone who had been in contact with infected patients.
quiz.explain_zh: contain＝控制、遏止（蔓延）。衛生官員關閉學校並追蹤接觸者以遏止疫情。

quiz.stem: There was something ______ about the letter: it had no stamp or return address, and the handwriting changed halfway through.
quiz.explain_zh: curious＝奇怪的。那封信沒有郵票和寄件地址，筆跡還中途改變，很奇怪。

quiz.stem: Because many elderly people in remote villages have never used a smartphone, experts warn that the digital ______ between generations is growing wider.
quiz.explain_zh: divide＝鴻溝、落差。偏鄉長者沒用過智慧型手機，世代間的數位落差擴大。

quiz.stem: Although Ms. Chen never raises her voice in class, she ______ great respect from her students because she always keeps her promises.
quiz.explain_zh: command＝博得（尊敬）。陳老師從不大聲說話，卻深受學生敬重。
